crossRefs.note: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.
All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down…
David therefore begged God for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night on the ground.
But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.

people.name: Mary
people.line: Sister of Martha and Lazarus, sat at Jesus' feet.

translations.web: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”
translations.bsb: When the Jews who were in the house consoling Mary saw how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
translations.kjv: The Jews then which were with her in the house, and comforted her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up hastily and went out, followed her, saying, She goeth unto the grave to weep there.
translations.asv: The Jews then who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, supposing that she was going unto the tomb to weep there.
